--- > [!NOTE] > **Low Risk** > Test-only change in one component-view spec; no app or API behavior changes. > > **Overview** > Stabilizes the **RecurringOrderDetailsView** component-view case that checks Cancel is hidden when the API marks an open order non-cancellable. > > The test now keeps the `recurringOrder` mock in a local variable and, after the summary appears, uses **`waitFor`** to assert both that the stub was called for the route order’s id/account and that the **Cancel** control is absent. That defers the negative assertion until after the fresh order response replaces the cancellable route params, matching the view’s `orderQuery.order ?? routeOrder` behavior and removing the race that caused intermittent CI failures. > > Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 79546bdb1b76bb05ed43320c18b875f620e62c3b.
